page.layout: One printed page: a single engraved plate filling the page, showing a naked man hanging by his feet from a tree or post against a landscape with hills, a town and a sea; a library stamp in blue lies over the lower right. No text blocks.
page.notes: Engraving: a flayed or suspended figure hanging head-down by one leg from a post, with hills, trees, a tower and a sailing boat in the background. No printed words are visible within the plate. The blue circular stamp (library stamp, partly legible as "BIBLIOTECA ... VITTORIO EMANUELE ... NAPOLI") is a library stamp and is not transcribed.
